description: Result of one Debug it run, sent by the Debug Job to the backend results port (POST /results/{runId}). Schema version 1. This file is the only contract shared by the Debug Job and the backend. All text fields are untrusted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result format. Always 1 for this schema.

explanation.description: Plain text explanation of why the job failed. When the patch is empty it gives the next step and the usual owner. Untrusted text.

causeLocation.description: Where the cause of the failure lies. `repository` is present only, and exactly, when `kind` is `extra-repository`.

oneOf.description: A cause outside any extra repository.

kind.description: this-repository: the failing repository; workflow-file: the workflow file; runner: the runner or runner image; infrastructure: the infrastructure; unknown: not determined.

oneOf.description: A cause in a named extra repository.

kind.description: The cause is in an extra repository.

repository.description: Name of the extra repository (its folder name under /work/repos).

patch.description: Proposed fix as a unified diff. File paths use the prefixes a/{folder}/{path} and b/{folder}/{path}, where {folder} is the repository name under /work/repos and {path} is the file path inside that repository. An empty patch ("") is valid: no change is proposed and the explanation gives the next step and the usual owner. Untrusted text.

costUsd.description: Anthropic API cost of the run in US dollars.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens used by the run.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens used by the run.

durationMs.description: Time the agent ran, in milliseconds.

logTruncated.description: True when the job log was over the log limit and only its last part was given to the agent.

failureReason.description: none: the run finished normally; time-limit: the time limit was hit; spend-limit: the spend limit was hit; error: the agent failed. Any explanation already produced is kept.
